output.technical_predicate: Optional "insights" processing is gated on a purpose-specific, affirmative, versioned consent record for that purpose; a "promotions" choice must not enable insights; core application use must not depend on insights consent.
applicability_facts: Scenario: adult user of core application; optional repayment insights initially off; marketing permission does not authorize private insights.
store.py:0088-0090 enabled() reads the latest choices row for the exact (owner, purpose) pair only — no cross-purpose fallback.
store.py:0092-0095 preference() accepts only purposes insights/promotions/objection and values on/off, and stores purpose, value, version (VERSION='2026-11-v1', store.py:0011) and timestamp.
store.py:0137-0139 report job runs only if enabled(owner,'insights'); store.py:0167-0168 report action requires enabled(who,'insights') else 409.
store.py:0100-0103 eligible_campaign() checks only 'promotions' and 'objection', never 'insights'.
views.py:0033-0036 renders separate per-purpose on/off controls; default state is off (no choices row => enabled() False).
views.py:0031-0032 application form has no insights consent field; store.py:0065-0083 submit() does not require any consent.
relevant_exceptions: No exception relied on: insights is optional and off by default, so no consent is needed for core application use.
Withdrawal path exists (store.py:0096-0098 cancels queued report jobs on insights off), consistent with consent being freely withdrawable; not an exception to the opt-in requirement.
required_controls: Purpose-scoped consent lookup keyed on (owner, purpose) with no fallback to other purposes (store.py:0088-0090).
Insights processing gate: report job and report action both require enabled(...,'insights') (store.py:0137, store.py:0167-0168).
Versioned, timestamped consent record per purpose (store.py:0094-0095, VERSION store.py:0011).
Separate UI controls per purpose with off-by-default state (views.py:0033-0036).
Core application submission independent of insights consent (store.py:0065-0083; views.py:0031-0032).
assessment_limits: Static source reading only; no execution, no runtime or database inspection performed.
Consent 'specific affirmative choice' is inferred from the on/off form control (views.py:0036); no separate granular consent-capture flow beyond the preference endpoint is visible.
No evidence of consent-record retention/expiry or re-consent on version change beyond storing VERSION per row.
Whether the notice text (store.py:0009) satisfies information duties under Art. 13 is outside this rule's scope.
No assessment of other GDPR obligations (e.g., Art. 6(1)(b) basis for core processing) beyond the named predicate.
